modernemb.embeddium.group.subtitle: %s pages
modernemb.embeddium.empty: No settings are available on this page.
modernemb.embeddium.unsaved_message: You have unapplied changes. Discard them and close?
modernemb.embeddium.restart_message: Some changes take effect after restarting the game.
modernemb.embeddium.apply_hint: Apply changes and keep this screen open
modernemb.embeddium.apply_failed_message: See the game log for details.
modernemb.embeddium.shaders.enable_hint: Turns the selected Oculus shader pack on or off. Applying reloads the shader pipeline.
modernemb.embeddium.shaders.pack_hint: Select the shader pack to apply. Its options are shown below after the pack is applied.
modernemb.embeddium.shaders.empty: No shader packs were found in the shaderpacks folder.
modernemb.embeddium.shaders.profile_hint: Apply a shader-pack profile, or adjust individual options below.
modernemb.embeddium.shaders.no_options: No editable options were found for the current shader pack. Enable shaders and apply, or use the native settings.
modernemb.embeddium.shaders.apply_pack_f: Apply the selected shader pack before editing its options.
modernemb.options.theme_preset.name: Palette
modernemb.options.theme_preset.tooltip: Auto follows Modern UI's own theme. The other presets use a fixed palette; Custom derives the whole palette from your accent and surface colors.
modernemb.options.theme_accent.name: Accent color
modernemb.options.theme_accent.tooltip: Main accent used by buttons, switches and selection. Available for the Custom color scheme.
modernemb.options.theme_surface.name: Surface color
modernemb.options.theme_surface.tooltip: Base color for cards and panels. Text, divider and card colors are derived from it so contrast stays readable.
modernemb.options.theme_corner_radius.to: Corner radius of cards and controls. Auto keeps Modern UI's value.
modernemb.options.theme_spacing.name: Content spacing
modernemb.options.theme_spacing.tooltip: Spacing between sections and cards. Auto keeps Modern UI's value.
modernemb.options.navigation_style.name: Navigation style
modernemb.options.navigation_style.toolt: Sidebar shows the ModernEmb mark, Classic shows the screen title, and Top moves the page list into a horizontal bar.
modernemb.options.glow_enabled.name: Enable glow
modernemb.options.glow_enabled.tooltip: Enables NarutoUI's shimmer wave on the selected parts of this screen.
modernemb.options.glow_palette.name: Glow palette
modernemb.options.glow_palette.tooltip: Preset ramps, Theme to follow the active color scheme, or Custom to build a light/core/deep band from two colors.
modernemb.options.glow_band.name: Custom glow band
modernemb.options.glow_band.tooltip: Pick a core color and a deep auxiliary color. Light tints and the mirrored nine-stop band are generated automatically.
modernemb.options.glow_speed.name: Glow speed
modernemb.options.glow_speed.tooltip: Speed of the shimmer wave. 100% is the default.
modernemb.options.glow_strength.name: Glow strength
modernemb.options.glow_strength.tooltip: How strongly the wave blends over the base color.
modernemb.options.glow_scale.name: Glow density
modernemb.options.glow_scale.tooltip: Spatial density of the wave. Higher values create more color changes across the screen.
modernemb.options.glow_navigation.name: Glow navigation labels
modernemb.options.glow_navigation.toolti: Applies the wave to the page labels in the navigation bar.
modernemb.options.glow_titles.name: Glow titles
modernemb.options.glow_titles.tooltip: Applies the wave to the rail or top-bar title and subtitle.
modernemb.options.glow_rows.name: Glow option rows
modernemb.options.glow_rows.tooltip: Applies the wave to every option row. This is the busiest visual setting.
